critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoint for jobs. Cleanup of disposable preview test jobs can only transition them to 'cancelled' and leave the record in Mongo. Consider adding an admin-only DELETE /api/jobs/{id} for QA/preview environments, or a Mongo TTL index for jobs whose customer starts with 'TEST_'.

App.js lines 304-316 runAgentReview surfaces reason.message; api() helper does raise Error(data?.error || ...), which is correct for FastAPI AppError responses (shape {error: ...}). FastAPI validation errors (shape {detail: ...}) would surface as the fallback 'Unable to save. Please retry.' Minor DX note (previously flagged in iteration_11).

App.js line 455 deep-link rehydrate effect depends only on auth?.user; if a user navigates between routes using window.history inside the SPA (deep link to /jobs/:id then back() pushes '/'), subsequent manual URL changes without full reload will not re-trigger. In practice the Back button clears job state via setJob(null), which is fine, but note the effect won't run on client-side route changes other than the initial load. Not a blocker.

Settings page (App.js line 402) renders [data-testid=build-info] only if `build` state is truthy; if /api/build-info returns 'unavailable' strings (fallback path in p2g/build_metadata.py), the UI will still render the string. Consider hiding when values equal 'unavailable'.
